_comment: What the developer site (Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles) already has for the app and its extensions, read by ci/capabilities.py. Add an entry in the same change that adds an entitlement, once its developer-site step is done (by Xcode's Apple ID on the Mac or by hand): the API key can't make app groups or turn on SharePlay, so a missing step otherwise shows only on release night.

com.apple.security.application-groups.step: App Groups on the identifier, with the group registered and chosen
